label: Commit search
placeholder: Search commits: message, author or SHA
hint: Searches message, author and SHA (from 4 characters) of all branches and tags – including beyond the loaded rows.
filtersHint: Narrow it with code:text (added or removed code), path:src/app, since:2026-01-01 or until:2026-06-30.
empty: No commit matches “{{query}}”. The search covered message, author and SHA of all branches and tags. Accented characters must be written exactly as in the commit.

meaning.placeholder: Describe what you are looking for – Enter searches
meaning.hint: Searches by meaning in all branches and tags. Each search is a request to the AI provider, so it starts with Enter.
meaning.author: author {{text}}
meaning.ignored: Not used because they are not valid: {{items}}
meaning.unranked: Not sorted by the AI – that request would need a confirmation (cost or monthly limit). Newest first.
meaning.capped: Only the newest {{limit}} commits are in the index.
meaning.routeRephrase: The AI turns the question into a search and sorts the matches.

limit: More than {{limit}} matches – showing the first {{limit}}. A more specific search term narrows it down.
